title: edaywalid/undo
claim: edaywalid/undo — Undo what the last shell command did to the filesystem
why_good: Undoes what your last shell command did to the filesystem — a genuinely scary gap (rm -rf regret) turned into a safety net.
value: Prosumer/team CLI safety tool; devs and ops would pay for reliable filesystem undo + audit.
risk: Hard to make truly reliable (snapshot/perf cost), and OS/filesystem snapshots partly cover it — trust is everything.

zh.claim: edaywalid/undo —— 撤销上一条 shell 命令对文件系统做的事。
zh.why_good: 撤销上一条 shell 命令对文件系统的改动——把一个真正吓人的缺口(rm -rf 后悔药)变成安全网。
zh.value: 面向开发者/团队的 CLI 安全工具;为可靠的文件系统撤销 + 审计,他们愿意付费。
zh.risk: 很难做到真正可靠(快照/性能成本),而系统/文件系统快照已部分覆盖——信任是关键。
